aus_nas_erklaerung: Choose a file. A copy is added to the document – the original stays where it is.
untertitel: Documents, spreadsheets and boards – on your own or together with other NAS users. Saving happens automatically.
tab_import_kaputt: The file is not a readable Excel or CSV spreadsheet.
tab_import_zu_gross: The spreadsheet is too large or too heavily compressed.
tab_fehlte_verbunden: {n} merged {n|cell range|cell ranges} (the content is in the first cell)
tab_formel_fehler: The formula contains an error – please check it.
tab_zu_viel: Too many cells at once (at most 50,000).
tab_zu_gross: The change is too large to send.
tab_rueckgaengig_geht_nicht: Undo isn’t possible here: the step is too large or no longer fits the sheet after simultaneous changes.
tab_weggefallen: Your last change was dropped – someone deleted the rows, columns or sheet at the same time.
tab_filter_erklaerung: The filter only applies to you. Everyone else still sees all rows.
tab_spaltenbreite: Drag to change the column width (double-click: default width)
tab_blatt_loeschen_frage: Delete sheet “{name}” with all its cells?
tab_zu_eng: There is no room left here. Move the sheet to another position.
tab_name_zeichen: These characters are not allowed: : \ / ? * [ ] and ' at the start or end.
tab_name_doppelt: Another sheet already has this name.
tab_einfuegen_tastatur: The browser does not allow pasting from the menu – please use Ctrl+V (Mac: ⌘+V).
leer_zuletzt: You have not opened anything yet.
leer_meine: You do not have any Office files yet.
leer_fuer_mich: Nobody has shared anything with you yet.
standardordner_erklaerung: New documents are saved here unless you choose otherwise. Personal folders are not available.
standardordner_keiner: None set yet – you choose a folder the next time you create something.
faellig_push_erklaerung: At 8 a.m. you get a message on your personal phone topic when board cards assigned to you are due that day.
name: Name
ordner_erklaerung: Choose a folder you can write to. Personal folders are not available.
name_vergeben: This name already exists in the folder. Choose another one.
name_ungueltig: The name must not contain / or \ and must not start with a dot.
status_offline: Offline – changes will be sent later
freigabe_erklaerung: People you share with work with your permissions, but only on this document.
privat_erklaerung: Private means: no other user has access. Admins on FAH-NAS can still open every share.
keine_freigaben: Not shared with anyone individually yet.
export_erklaerung: Choose the format. The file is downloaded; the Office document stays as it is.
extern_text: The file was changed outside Office (for example via SMB or from a snapshot). Your latest changes are not in the new version.
neu_laden_text: The connection was gone for too long or a change was rejected. The document was reloaded; your latest changes are not in it.
kopie_sichern: Save my version as a copy
kopie_gesichert: Your version is now saved next to it as “{name}”.
extern_neu_geladen: The file was changed elsewhere and has been reloaded.
geloescht_meldung: The document is now in the recycle bin.
hinweis_schnappschuesse: Older versions can only be restored from snapshots – none are set up for this share.
art_fehlt: This document type is not available yet.
board_archiv_erklaerung: Archived cards are no longer shown on the board. Open a card to restore it.
board_etiketten_erklaerung: Labels apply to the whole board. A deleted label disappears from all cards.
board_spalte_loeschen_frage: Delete column “{name}” with {anzahl} {anzahl|card|cards}? This cannot be undone.
board_keine_spalten: This board has no columns yet.
board_karte_titel_platzhalter: Card title, press Enter to add
board_zu_eng: There is no room left here. Put the card somewhere else.
board_anhang_zu_gross: “{name}” is larger than 100 MiB and was not attached.
board_karte_loeschen_frage: Delete card “{titel}”? This cannot be undone.
import_nicht_verfuegbar: This file type cannot be imported into Office yet.
import_abgebrochen: The import into “{name}” stopped ({fehler}). The empty document is in the folder – you can delete it.
wird_nachgereicht: Your latest changes are still being sent – keep this tab open until the connection is back.
verschwunden_text: The file was moved or deleted outside Office. Your latest changes are not in it – save them as a copy.
geloescht_text: The document is now in the recycle bin. Your latest changes are not in it – save them as a copy.
verschoben_meldung: The file was moved or deleted outside Office. Open it again from Files.
kopie_ordner_erklaerung: You cannot write to the original's folder. Choose a folder for your version.
dok_eingabe_verworfen: Your input could not be applied – please type it again.
dok_link_erklaerung: Allowed are addresses starting with https://, http:// or mailto:. Leave empty to remove the link.
dok_tabelle_grenze: No more rows or columns are possible.
dok_bild_typ: Only PNG, JPEG, GIF and WebP images can be inserted.
dok_kommentar_loeschen_frage: Delete this comment and all its replies?
dok_kommentar_auswahl: First select the text you want to comment on.
dok_import_zu_gross: The file is too large or too heavily compressed.
dok_import_kaputt: The file is not a readable Word document.
dok_fehlte_bilder: {n} {n|image|images} in an unsupported format or linked
dok_fehlte_tabellengroesse: table parts beyond 200 rows, 50 columns or 20,000 characters per cell
